system.description:
You become an unstoppable force of nature — nearly impossible to halt, and nearly impossible to harm — grinding forward through anything that dares stand in your path.

Anyone trying to block or restrain you fails automatically unless they possess Potence equal to your Fortitude, in which case a normal Physical Challenge decides whether you are forced to stop. Whenever damage is inflicted on you, win a Simple Test to ignore aggravated damage entirely (a tie converts it to lethal), or win or tie to ignore lethal damage entirely; all bashing damage is simply ignored. You cannot walk through walls or deliberately crush people by walking into them, and when two Juggernaut users meet, the power is negated against one another.
